sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
In 2023, HSNSW undertook a trial of autonomous floor scrubbing technology within a hospital environment to evaluate the potential benefits of cleaning automation. Outcomes from this trial identified opportunities to improve cleaning consistency, enhance workforce utilisation, reduce repetitive manual handling activities, and improve visibility of cleaning activities through digital reporting and telemetry.
Since completion of the trial, autonomous cleaning technologies have continued to mature considerably. HSNSW is now seeking to assess a broader range of cleaning automation solutions, including autonomous floor scrubbers, autonomous vacuum cleaners.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
This Expression of Interest forms the first stage of a three-stage procurement process intended to:
• Understand current market capability.
• Assess the maturity of available technologies.
• Evaluate suitability for healthcare environments.
• Identify suppliers for participation in a structured trial program.
• Inform future procurement and implementation decisions.
The procurement process will follow a multi-stage approach:
• Phase 1: Expression of Interest (EOI)
• Phase 2: Placement Trials
• Phase 3: Request for Tender (RFT)
